credentials.name: HPWKI — Supervisory Board member (Pengawas · Anggota), held by founder Agung Sambuko
credentials.category: Himpunan Pelaku Wisata Khusus Ijen — Ijen special-tourism association, supervised by BBKSDA Jawa Timur
credentials.sourceNote: Corrected 2026-08-21 in organization.json and 2026-08-22 here. The document is Menkumham decree AHU-0001072.AH.01.07.TAHUN 2024 establishing HPWKI as a legal entity; its annex lists AGUNG SAMBUKO as PENGAWAS · ANGGOTA. So this is a named supervisory seat held by the founder, not a corporate membership held by PT Java Volcano Rendezvous, and AHU-0001072 is HPWKI's own legal-entity number rather than a JVTO membership number. This file was missed in the first pass and llms.txt renders its Credentials block from here, so the corrected label existed in the canonical record while the old one kept being published.

credentials.name: BBKSDA Jawa Timur circular — TWA Kawah Ijen reopening and climbing conditions (press-reported)
credentials.category: Conservation-authority circular reported as introducing the doctor's-letter requirement for crater entry. NOT held as a document: cited from the press, not published here with a hash.
credentials.sourceNote: Status 2026-08-22, stated plainly because this is the one credential on the site that cannot be checked the way all the others can. Two things are true and should not be conflated. (1) The REQUIREMENT is solid: TIMES Indonesia (6 Jan 2024) quotes the head of the TWA Kawah Ijen post, Kompas (5 Jan 2024) lists it among the reopening conditions, and it is enforced at the gate. (2) The CIRCULAR NUMBER is now corroborated by three independent outlets: TIMES Indonesia (6 Jan 2024), detikJatim (5 Jan 2024, citing Dwi Putro Sugiarto, Kepala Seksi Konservasi BKSDA Wilayah V Banyuwangi), and Liputan6 (6 Jan 2024, citing Sigit Hariwibowo, Kepala Pos TWA Kawah Ijen). All three print 'SE.35/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/1/2024'. The document itself is not held on file. TO CLOSE: obtain the circular from BBKSDA Jawa Timur, publish it verbatim (a scan or photo is fine — do not retype or tidy it, the forensic value is in the original), then fill documentUrl + sha256 here. If the document that turns up carries a different number or date, the attribution in travel-guide/ijen-health-screening.source.json and llms.txt must be corrected with it, not left to contradict its own source.

credentials.name: BBKSDA SE.1658/K2/BIDTEK.1/KSA/9/2024
credentials.category: Conservation-authority circular governing access to TWA Kawah Ijen. A regulation JVTO operates under, not a permit issued to JVTO. It reopens the crater from 2024-09-08 and names basic climbing safety gear plus 'protokol kesehatan yang berlaku'. The health-certificate rule itself is published by the Ministry of Forestry (see relatedAuthority).

relatedAuthority.name: Ayo ke Taman Nasional — TWA Kawah Ijen, Ministry of Forestry
relatedAuthority.quote: Visitors are required to bring and show a valid health certificate issued no more than 3 days before the visit date.
